items.source_name: The Hindu (verified IG reel) / NDTV / IANS wire outlets
items.summary: Former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee posted on X on Oct 20 condemning the 2-day extension of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka's judicial custody as 'state-sponsored terrorism' and 'police-sponsored atrocities', accusing authorities of targeting Gen Z youth and assaulting democracy, and demanding the duo's immediate release. The Hindu's verified IG reel (posted 09:46:16Z Oct 21) carried the X post alongside the Crime Branch transfer story; NDTV, Times of Bangladesh and IANS-wire outlets (Freedom Press, Daily World, hiINDiA, Ghanamma) carried the same statement.
items.title: Mamata Banerjee calls Das-Ranka custody extension 'state-sponsored terrorism', demands immediate release

items.source_name: The Sen Times (PTI) / The Freedom Press (IANS) / Nation Press / The Orissa Today
items.summary: BJD president and former Odisha CM Naveen Patnaik posted on X on Oct 20 demanding the judicial custody of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka be 'urgently reviewed' and the duo 'released immediately', saying hoisting the National Flag even in a prohibited area should not warrant prolonged detention and that the judiciary and executive must ensure youth don't lose faith in the rule of law. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke thanked him on X ('Thank you sir for standing with Saurav and Ashu'). Odisha BJP hit back, accusing Patnaik of politicising the issue and linking it to the SIR debate.
items.title: Naveen Patnaik demands immediate release of Das and Ranka; Odisha BJP hits back
